other_conditions: The deceased construction worker must be registered with the Bihar Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (BBOCWWB) and have an active membership at the time of death.
Only the legal heir or dependent family member of the deceased registered worker is eligible to apply.
benefits_summary: Up to ₹4,00,000 for accidental death, ₹2,00,000 for natural death (₹1,00,000 if disaster aid already received).
